name: FFB
recent: 近期公告主要是雇员公积金局（EPF）及主要股东、董事的持股变动申报，多名董事在公开市场增持股份。新闻方面，市场关注公司在柬埔寨的扩张计划以及马来西亚乳制品市场竞争。
notable: 集团董事经理兼集团首席执行官 Loi Tuan Ee 在公开市场增持公司股份。
非独立非执行董事 Loi Foon Kion 在公开市场增持公司股份。
独立非执行董事 Jocelyn Ng Lai Leng 在公开市场增持公司股份。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为3.0637亿令吉，环比增长11.4%，同比增长17.6%；净利为2682.3万令吉，环比下降3.9%，同比下降18.2%；净利率为8.8%，低于上一季度的10.1%。

recent_en: Recent announcements mainly involve shareholding change notifications by the EPF and substantial shareholders/directors, with several directors acquiring shares in the open market. In the news, focus is on the company's Cambodia expansion plan and competition in Malaysia's dairy market.
notable_en: Group Managing Director and Group CEO Loi Tuan Ee acquired shares in the open market.
Non-Independent Non-Executive Director Loi Foon Kion acquired shares in the open market.
Independent Non-Executive Director Jocelyn Ng Lai Leng acquired shares in the open market.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 306.37 million, up 11.4% QoQ and 17.6% YoY; net income was MYR 26.823 million, down 3.9% QoQ and 18.2% YoY; net margin was 8.8%, lower than 10.1% in the previous quarter.
